info.title: Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) API

requests.description: Returns a list of the sensitive information types that DLP API supports. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/infotypes-reference to learn more.
requests.name: GET /v2/infoTypes
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Deletes a stored infoType. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/creating-stored-infotypes to learn more.
requests.name: DELETE /v2/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets a stored infoType. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/creating-stored-infotypes to learn more.
requests.name: GET /v2/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the stored infoType by creating a new version. The existing version will continue to be used until the new version is ready. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/creating-stored-infotypes to learn more.
requests.name: PATCH /v2/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Activate a job trigger. Causes the immediate execute of a trigger instead of waiting on the trigger event to occur.
requests.name: POST /v2/{name}:activate
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Starts asynchronous cancellation on a long-running DlpJob. The server makes a best effort to cancel the DlpJob, but success is not guaranteed. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/inspecting-storage and https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/compute-risk-analysis to learn more.
requests.name: POST /v2/{name}:cancel
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Finish a running hybrid DlpJob. Triggers the finalization steps and running of any enabled actions that have not yet run.
requests.name: POST /v2/{name}:finish
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Inspect hybrid content and store findings to a trigger. The inspection will be processed asynchronously. To review the findings monitor the jobs within the trigger.
requests.name: POST /v2/{name}:hybridInspect
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: De-identifies potentially sensitive info from a ContentItem. This method has limits on input size and output size. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/deidentify-sensitive-data to learn more. When no InfoTypes or CustomInfoTypes are specified in this request, the system will automatically choose what detectors to run. By default this may be all types, but may change over time as detectors are updated.
requests.name: POST /v2/{parent}/content:deidentify
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Finds potentially sensitive info in content. This method has limits on input size, processing time, and output size. When no InfoTypes or CustomInfoTypes are specified in this request, the system will automatically choose what detectors to run. By default this may be all types, but may change over time as detectors are updated. For how to guides, see https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/inspecting-images and https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/inspecting-text,
requests.name: POST /v2/{parent}/content:inspect
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Re-identifies content that has been de-identified. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/pseudonymization#re-identification_in_free_text_code_example to learn more.
requests.name: POST /v2/{parent}/content:reidentify
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_DATA_LOSS_PREVENTION_DLP_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new job to inspect storage or calculate risk metrics.
